text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—Members of the press. That concludes our 
overview of Project L'Arc.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
We will continue to keep the public 
updated on their achievements. So 
please...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Please look forward to their victory.

text_block_list.name: Man in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Tracen Academy. Are they aiming for 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe again?

text_block_list.name: Woman in Plaid Pants
text_block_list.text:
And there are double-digit participants, 
right? Man, I just hope to at least make 
the board~.

A few months after the project began, a 
joint training session was held on this 
day.

text_block_list.name: Sirius & Nakayama
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: This is my win... ngh, Nakayama...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You two-! Let's cool down after running-!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san is totally on board too! She 
said she wants to massage the winner's 
muscles!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hear that, Sirius? Lucky you, huh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"That was close-desu ne~. 
Nakayama-senpai."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Accelerating from the 3rd corner was 
effective. ...As long as she had enough 
stamina.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Are you provoking me?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It is a fact, a suggestion, advice.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Failing to finish the race with a strategy 
you came up with yourself clearly shows a 
lack of muscle and stamina, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...Why are you in such a rush to win the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe? Is there a 
reason?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ………………Who knows.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, are you sure about this? 
Giving advice to a rival, I mean.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! Of course, desu! After all, El is 
the world's strongest horse girl!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
For a world-class performance, sparks 
flying with top-tier rivals are an 
absolute must!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El is going to become the greatest of the 
strongest, desu! If you stay a weakling 
rival, El won't have anyone to compete 
against!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haaah...?

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Attention, everyone! All Trainers 
participating in Project L'Arc, please 
report to the classroom immediately—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Just the trainers? Then it has nothing 
to do with us.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
El, come with me. Since you were able to 
point out what I'm missing, you must know 
how to deal with it too, right?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, fellow Trainers! It's time for 
the Trainer Enhancement Program!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has a PC, right? There are 200 
questions loaded onto them.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, cheating is also allowed.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! This isn't a test. It's a workbook 
whose purpose is for you to discover, look 
up, and learn what you don't know.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It's okay to answer incorrectly. The 
question will keep repeating until you get 
it right.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You may leave as soon as you answer all 
questions correctly. I will return to 
collect the equipment once everyone is 
gone.
choice_data_list:
(A workbook for the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, huh…)

text_block_list.text:
"Winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
demands excellence not just from the 
Umamusume, but from her Trainer as well."
For <chrname>'s sake too, I need to study!

"Weather: Clear. However, due to heavy 
rain the previous day, the track is 
yielding, and two of the top contenders 
are front-runners. Predict the race 
development and formulate a strategy." ...

"Even without drinking it directly, what 
symptoms arise from incompatible local 
water? Circle all that apply"...

“Translate the following sentence into 
French: ‘The joint in my right knee is 
throbbing with pain.’”...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: Ah... All done. Where's Trainer <username>...?
choice_data_list: It looks like it'll take a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't push yourself too hard. You're 
still a rookie, after all."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: All right, came to pick it up... and done.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Trainer <username>!? You're still here!?
choice_data_list:
Sorry, I'll have it finished in just a 
moment!

text_block_list.text:
20 questions left. ...I don't know if we 
can call that "almost done."
choice_data_list: (But I don't want to give up.)

text_block_list.text:
"...Even if one wishes for that, time will 
inevitably run out."

Unable to close the gap with the Trainers 
who left before them, the end will surely 
come.

"Even so, I couldn't strike the keyboard. 
Because the answer had not yet come to 
mind."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Do you still want to give it a try, 
Trainer <username>?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

It was an hour later that all the 
questions were finally solved.

Two hours had passed since all the other 
Trainers had left.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Good work! You held on well out there.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You did great. ...You showed me something 
really wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: My goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I have to do my best, too...!
